news.analysis: Aside from an early fourth-quarter pick deep into n Carolina territory, Love was pretty locked in on Thursday. The Panthers did not generate much of a pass rush, failing to sack Love even once, and that kept the Green Bay QB comfortable in the pocket most of the night. Love has thrown an interception in three straight games now, but he has countered that with six touchdown passes and an additional score on the ground. He's also averaged just under 280 passing yards per game in that span.
news.contents: Jordan Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.title: Jordan Love fires three TD passes in Thursday night win

news.contents: Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards and three touchdowns, with one interception in his team's 27-19 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Thursday Night Football.
